The vendor directly providing **BlueGPT** at **bluegpt.app** is **InspireLabs** (**InspireLabs SAS**).

### Evidence and Citations
* **Company / Provider Documentation:** On its platform documentation and site listings, the operating entity behind BlueGPT is stated as: *"BlueGPT Company name: InspireLabs"* and *"Copyright © InspireLabs - All rights reserved"*.
* **Trademark & Corporate Registry:** The European Union trademark for **BLUEGPT** was registered by **INSPIRELABS**, a French simplified joint-stock company (*Société par actions simplifiée*, SIREN 948 309 059, based in Toulouse, France) co-founded by Justine Morin and Quentin Camboulives. (The platform has also transitioned under the name VelvetYuzu under the same operating company).
